what: Measured records of the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next profile. Every row NF never measured is BORROWED from qwen27b by name (UNIFY_PLAN Risiko (c)); an NF record of the same name replaces it.

records.name: P_DRAFT_RESIDENT_BUDGET_MIB
records.provenance: boot fnFL2v71 (21.09.): packed vocab 615.7 (d84f1394fe) + INT4 g32 mtp 1522.7 MiB (a905902f47), 1da8f29f12
records.power_limit_source: not recorded: the boot predates the 24.09. reading and row 27 (no POWER-LIMIT line)

borrow.why: the 27B measurement the NF line has read since its base 76f8debf2c; kept so the NF argv stays byte-identical (P_/D_OVERSHOOT_MIB shape it), printed as BORROWED by the launcher. Replacing a row needs an NF control boot (P_/D_OVERSHOOT first).
